findings.message:
BadgerYieldSource.balanceOfToken(address) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1870-1876) uses a dangerous strict equality:
	- balances[addr] == 0 (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1871)
findings.name: incorrect-equality

findings.message:
Reentrancy in BadgerYieldSource.redeemToken(uint256) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1895-1919):
	External calls:
	- badgerSett.withdraw(requiredSharesBalance) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1911)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[msg.sender] = balances[msg.sender].sub(requiredSharesBalance) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1916)
findings.name: reentrancy-benign

findings.message:
Reentrancy in BadgerYieldSource.supplyTokenTo(uint256,address) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1881-1890):
	External calls:
	- badger.transferFrom(msg.sender,address(this),amount) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1882)
	- badger.approve(address(badgerSett),amount) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1883)
	- badgerSett.deposit(amount) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1886)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- balances[to] = balances[to].add(balanceDiff) (14_BadgerYieldSource.sol#1889)
findings.name: reentrancy-benign
